look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn red marks, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel 02.mp3, 68.8 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone.

scenes.name: One laptop
scenes.desc: A closed laptop opens on a desk; its screen shows the $6.3B headline. ONE LAPTOP.

scenes.name: $6.3 billion
scenes.desc: $6.3B counts up beside the CNBC headline, a bar four times the old record, then coins and a stopwatch: about 20 minutes.

scenes.name: Crack the vault?
scenes.desc: The padlock on a vault door cracks open and a key flies out. CRACK THE VAULT?

scenes.name: No keys leaked
scenes.desc: The padlock stays shut under the magnifier; stamped NO KEYS LEAKED.

scenes.name: The signer
scenes.desc: A hand reaches past the locked padlock for a SIGN button and presses it.

scenes.name: Laptop to wallets
scenes.desc: Diagram lights up one box at a time: laptop, service container, signing system, wallets.

scenes.name: Allowed to ask
scenes.desc: The key is crossed out; a pen signs: allowed to ask for a signature.

scenes.name: More than one door
scenes.desc: ONE LAPTOP is crossed out for MORE THAN ONE ENTRY POINT; three doors; postmortem not out yet.

scenes.name: Your weak point
scenes.desc: You at your desk with laptop and phone: the device you log in from, the email that resets everything.

scenes.name: Lock it down
scenes.desc: HARDWARE KEY / PASSKEY hits, then WITHDRAWAL ALLOWLIST with a checklist.

scenes.name: Scam DM
scenes.desc: A fake support DM asks for a code; stamped SCAM.

scenes.name: The laptop is
scenes.desc: The open laptop from the start closes: the vault isn't yours to secure, the laptop is.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
